segments.sn35.103:1.1: “Udako [uddako (sī. pī.)] sudaṃ, bhikkhave, rāmaputto evaṃ vācaṃ bhāsati –
segments.sn35.103:1.2: ‘idaṃ jātu vedagū, idaṃ jātu sabbajī [sabbaji (pī.)], idaṃ jātu apalikhataṃ gaṇḍamūlaṃ palikhaṇin’ti.
segments.sn35.103:1.6: Taṃ kho panetaṃ, bhikkhave, udako rāmaputto avedagūyeva samāno ‘vedagūsmī’ti bhāsati, asabbajīyeva samāno ‘sabbajīsmī’ti bhāsati, apalikhataṃyeva gaṇḍamūlaṃ palikhataṃ me ‘gaṇḍamūlan’ti bhāsati.
segments.sn35.103:1.7: Idha kho taṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhu sammā vadamāno vadeyya –
segments.sn35.103:1.8: ‘idaṃ jātu vedagū, idaṃ jātu sabbajī, idaṃ jātu apalikhataṃ gaṇḍamūlaṃ palikhaṇin’”ti.
segments.sn35.103:2.2: Yato kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu channaṃ phassāyatanānaṃ samudayañca atthaṅgamañca assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti;
segments.sn35.103:2.3: evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu vedagū hoti.
segments.sn35.103:3.2: Yato kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu channaṃ phassāyatanānaṃ samudayañca atthaṅgamañca assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtaṃ viditvā anupādāvimutto hoti;
segments.sn35.103:3.3: evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu sabbajī hoti.
segments.sn35.103:4.1: “Kathañca, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno apalikhataṃ gaṇḍamūlaṃ palikhataṃ hoti?
segments.sn35.103:4.2: Gaṇḍoti kho, bhikkhave, imassetaṃ cātumahābhūtikassa kāyassa adhivacanaṃ mātāpettikasambhavassa odanakummāsūpacayassa aniccucchādanaparimaddanabhedanaviddhaṃsanadhammassa.
segments.sn35.103:4.4: Yato kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno taṇhā pahīnā hoti ucchinnamūlā tālāvatthukatā anabhāvaṅkatā āyatiṃ anuppādadhammā;
segments.sn35.103:4.5: evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno apalikhataṃ gaṇḍamūlaṃ palikhataṃ hoti.
segments.sn35.103:5.1: “Udako sudaṃ, bhikkhave, rāmaputto evaṃ vācaṃ bhāsati –
segments.sn35.103:5.2: ‘idaṃ jātu vedagū, idaṃ jātu sabbajī, idaṃ jātu apalikhataṃ gaṇḍamūlaṃ palikhaṇin’ti.
segments.sn35.103:5.6: Taṃ kho panetaṃ, bhikkhave, udako rāmaputto avedagūyeva samāno ‘vedagūsmī’ti bhāsati, asabbajīyeva samāno ‘sabbajīsmī’ti bhāsati; apalikhataṃyeva gaṇḍamūlaṃ ‘palikhataṃ me gaṇḍamūlan’ti bhāsati.
segments.sn35.103:5.7: Idha kho taṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhu sammā vadamāno vadeyya –
segments.sn35.103:5.8: ‘idaṃ jātu vedagū, idaṃ jātu sabbajī, idaṃ jātu apalikhataṃ gaṇḍamūlaṃ palikhaṇin’”ti.
segments.sn35.103:6.1: Dve saṃgayhā parihānaṃ, pamādavihārī ca saṃvaro;

lines: Atha vā idaṃ mama vacanaṃ suṇāthāti dīpento evamāha.
Jātu vedagūti ahaṃ ekaṃseneva vedagū, vedasaṅkhātena ñāṇena neyyesu gato, vedaṃ vā gato adhigato, paṇḍitohamasmīti attho.
Sabbajīti ekaṃsena sabbavaṭṭaṃ jinitvā abhibhavitvā ṭhitosmīti vadati.
Mātāpettikasambhavassāti mātito ca pitito ca nibbattena mātāpettikena sukkasoṇitena sambhūtassa.
Odanakummāsūpacayassāti odanena ceva kummāsena ca upacitassa vaḍḍhitassa.

Aniccucchādanaparimaddanabhedanaviddhaṃsanadhammassāti ettha ayaṃ kāyo hutvā abhāvaṭṭhena aniccadhammo, duggandhavighātatthāya tanuvilepanena ucchādanadhammo, aṅgapaccaṅgābādhavinodanatthāya khuddakasambāhanena parimaddanadhammo, daharakāle vā ūrūsu sayāpetvā gabbhavāsena dussaṇṭhitānaṃ tesaṃ tesaṃ aṅgānaṃ saṇṭhānasampādanatthaṃ añchanapīḷanādīnaṃ vasena parimaddanadhammo, evaṃ pariharitopi ca bhedanaviddhaṃsanadhammo bhijjati ceva vikirati ca, evaṃ sabhāvoti attho.
Ucchādanaṃ vā parimaddanamattamevāti katvā na gahitaṃ.
